title: Technical Product Manager - ServiceNow SPM & AI
description:
Job Description
**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI\-led, platform\-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what's next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry\-leading organizations across the world, including 20 Fortune 50 companies and 4 of the 5 top banks in both the US and India, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor's mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We reported $1,654\.4M FY26 revenue with 17\.4% Y\-o\-Y growth. We have delivered 24 sequential quarters of growth with $436\.0M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 3\.2% Q\-o\-Q and 16\.2% Y\-o\-Y growth. Our 27,500\+ global team members, located in 18 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We have been recognized as the Fastest Growing IT Services Brand Globally in the 2026 Brand Finance IT Services 25 Report. We named a Leader in the Everest Group Private Equity (PE) Services PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026 and Software Product Engineering PEAK Matrix Assessment 2026\.

 **About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Technical Product Manager with deep expertise in ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) and strong knowledge of the ServiceNow platform. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving product strategy, roadmap planning, stakeholder alignment, and successful delivery of enterprise portfolio management capabilities. This role requires a unique blend of product management expertise, platform knowledge, business process understanding, and AI\-driven innovation. The successful candidate will work closely with business leaders, PMOs, finance teams, architects, developers, and platform teams to maximize business value through ServiceNow SPM and emerging AI capabilities.

* **Role: Technical Product Manager \- ServiceNow SPM \& AI**
* **Location: All Persistent Locations**
* **Experience: 8 to 12 Years**
* **Job Type: Full\-Time Employment**

 **What You'll Do:**

  

* Own and manage the product vision, roadmap, strategy, and backlog for ServiceNow SPM capabilities.
* Define product objectives aligned with business priorities and strategic goals.
* Collaborate with business, PMO, finance, and technology stakeholders to prioritize initiatives.
* Translate business requirements into scalable product features and platform capabilities.
* Lead roadmap planning, release management, adoption strategies, and value realization programs.
* Define success metrics, KPIs, and measurable business outcomes.
* Drive implementation and optimization of Demand Management processes including idea intake, demand scoring, assessments, and prioritization.
* Lead Project and Program Management capabilities including governance, milestones, RAID management, and project health reporting.
* Manage Portfolio Management processes including investment planning, portfolio reviews, and strategic alignment.
* Enable Resource Management capabilities including capacity planning, forecasting, allocation, and utilization tracking.
* Support Financial Management processes including budget planning, benefit realization, cost management, and CAPEX/OPEX tracking.
* Drive Strategic Planning initiatives leveraging OKRs, strategic themes, roadmaps, and outcome tracking.
* Support Agile Development and Enterprise Agile Planning initiatives through backlog management, PI planning, and engineering integration.
* Develop executive dashboards, portfolio KPIs, value realization metrics, financial reports, and governance reporting.
* Drive adoption of Generative AI, Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, and Agentic AI capabilities within ServiceNow.
* Identify opportunities for AI\-driven portfolio optimization and automation.
* Leverage AI for resource forecasting, strategic prioritization, demand scoring, and executive insights.
* Collaborate with platform teams to incorporate intelligent automation into business processes.
* Define AI adoption frameworks and measurable business outcomes.
* Ensure AI initiatives align with governance, compliance, and responsible AI principles.
* Partner with executive stakeholders, PMOs, finance teams, and business leaders to define priorities and success criteria.
* Facilitate workshops, roadmap discussions, and governance reviews.
* Define portfolio governance processes and reporting frameworks.
* Create executive\-level reporting and communicate product performance and business outcomes.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and drive alignment across business and technology teams.
* Act as the primary point of contact for SPM product strategy and platform enhancements.
* Work closely with architects, developers, platform administrators, and QA teams to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Manage product backlogs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint priorities.
* Support Agile delivery processes including sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet business, operational, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvement and platform optimization initiatives.
* Monitor product adoption, user feedback, and business value realization.

 **Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 8\-12 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, or Enterprise Platform Management roles.
* Proven experience managing ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) implementations and enhancements.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, workflows, integrations, reporting, and automation capabilities.
* Experience managing product roadmaps, product strategies, and stakeholder expectations.
* Deep expertise in Demand Management, Project Management, Program Management, and Portfolio Management processes.
* Strong understanding of Resource Management, Financial Management, and Strategic Planning within ServiceNow SPM.
* Experience with Objectives \& Key Results (OKRs), portfolio governance, and enterprise planning frameworks.
* Knowledge of Agile Development, Enterprise Agile Planning, PI Planning, and backlog management practices.
* Experience with Performance Analytics, executive dashboards, KPI reporting, and business insights generation.
* Understanding of ServiceNow SPM data models, tables, workspace experiences, and platform governance.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and executive stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance business priorities with technical platform capabilities.
* Experience working with cross\-functional global teams.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise transformation, PMO governance, and portfolio optimization initiatives.
* Experience leveraging Generative AI, Now Assist, Predictive Intelligence, and Agentic AI capabilities.
* Ability to identify AI\-driven opportunities across portfolio and project management processes.
* Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, and enterprise AI adoption strategies.
* Experience measuring and demonstrating business value from AI implementations.
* Understanding of intelligent automation and data\-driven decision\-making frameworks.

 **Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company\-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting\-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check\-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents

 **Values\-Driven, People\-Centric \& Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility\-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment

 **Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent \-** **persistent.com/careers**

 ***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."***

description:
The Senior Business Analyst programs and configures software to business needs. Under limited supervision, this job identifies and analyzes business software needs, writes complex code to optimize the performance and efficiency of the organization's information technology (IT) platform and infrastructure and conducts testing to ensure programs are functioning properly. This job is considered a subject matter expert in the applications development and support area.

* Tests the resulting coding components in accordance with company standards and as defined in approved testing plans.

We're looking for an AI Product Owner to drive the definition, prioritization, and delivery of AI\-enabled product capabilities. * Lead end\-to\-end requirement gathering through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and process walkthroughs

**Required Qualifications**

* 8–15 years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or Program Management within technology\-driven environments
* Strong hands\-on experience with requirement gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management across cross\-functional teams
* Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into detailed user stories and acceptance criteria
* Working knowledge of AI/ML product concepts (LLMs, agentic workflows, automation platforms) — technical depth not required, but fluency in AI product trade\-offs is expected
* Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to senior stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Asset Management or broader financial services domain
* Exposure to automation platforms (e.g., Unqork, Automation Anywhere) or AI agent/LLM\-based tooling
Certifications such as CSPO, POPM

title: Product Engineer - Golang
description:
A Product Engineer – Golang responsible for building high\-performance, cross\-platform product components, background services, and system modules for device management platforms. Requires strong Go, concurrency, OS fundamentals, REST APIs, networking, and debugging skills with 3–5 years of experience.


###### **Experience**


3–5 years


###### **Job Type**


Full time


###### **Location**


* Pune
* Gurugram
###### **Date Posted**


Sep 22, 2026


ProMobi Technologies Pvt. Ltd.


#### **Role Overview**


We are looking for a hands\-on Product Engineer – Golang to build high\-performance, cross\-platform software components that power our device management platform. This is not a traditional backend development role. You will develop platform services, system modules, background agents, and core product components that interact with operating systems, devices, and network services. The ideal candidate has strong Golang fundamentals, enjoys solving systems\-level challenges, and is passionate about building reliable, scalable software products.


#### **Key Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, test, and maintain cross\-platform services, modules, and product components using Golang.
* Build scalable and reliable background services that run efficiently across different operating systems.
* Develop software that interacts with operating system APIs, devices, network services, and platform resources.
* Write concurrent applications using Go’s concurrency primitives such as goroutines, channels, mutexes, and synchronization packages.
* Optimize applications for performance, scalability, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Develop and consume REST APIs and integrate with internal platform services.
* Troubleshoot production issues related to concurrency, networking, and system interactions.
* Collaborate with product managers, architects, QA, and engineering teams to deliver high\-quality product features.

#### **Must\-Have Skills**


* Strong programming experience in Golang with solid understanding of Go fundamentals, including interfaces, error handling, package design, modules, testing, and the standard library.
* Good understanding of Go concurrency concepts including goroutines, channels, context, mutexes, WaitGroups, and synchronization.
* Knowledge of operating system fundamentals including processes, threads, memory management, filesystems, and inter\-process communication.
* Experience designing and consuming REST APIs.
* Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills.
* Understanding of software engineering best practices including version control, testing, and code reviews.

#### **Good\-to\-Have Skills**


* Experience with Go networking libraries (net, net/http) and network programming.Understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, WebSockets, gRPC, sockets, or similar networking protocols.
* Experience developing applications for Windows, Linux, and/or macOS.
* Exposure to device management, endpoint management, systems programming, or security products.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud\-native technologies.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing.
* Basic exposure to frontend technologies for supporting management consoles or UI integrations.

#### **What We’re Looking For**


* Strong ownership and accountability for assigned features.
* Passion for building high\-quality product software.
* Ability to independently deliver features with guidance from senior engineers when needed.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.

ProMobi Technologies is one of the fastest\-growing bootstrapped SaaS companies. Scalefusion \- our flagship product is a leading mobile device \& endpoint management software helping businesses to secure and manage a fleet of mobile devices and diverse endpoints including smartphones, tablets, laptops, rugged devices, POS, and digital signages.

description:
**vConstruct** is a construction technology company based in Pune, India. vConstruct specializes in providing services and solutions in Virtual Design and Construction (VDC), Project Controls Management, Accounting, Data Science and Analytics and Software Development.


vConstruct, an entrepreneurial organization, has forayed into product development for construction by leveraging its deep understanding of construction processes and driven by our deeply rooted core value of Ever forward Spirit.


vConstruct is looking for people who are passionate about transforming the construction industry by using technology.


vConstruct made a commitment to this journey of product development by starting “vC Labs” in 2022\. vC Labs is a dedicated team of people who come from the construction domain and technology domain to build solutions for problems we see in the construction management workflows by leveraging 3D web and mobile development, data science and analytics, AI/ML etc.


In less than a year of existence, the team has grown to 20 and has built 6 solutions that solve real world problems in construction management workflows for various vConstruct teams. These solutions also hold potential for similar users in the construction industry beyond vConstruct. The team has also come up with the initial prototype of the industry leading product based on the theme of BIM enabled integrated workflows.


With a vision to transform the construction industry by the use of technology, we truly believe that we will bring upon the transition not just by services but by market facing products as well.


We are seeking a driven and domain\-minded **Product Owner** to take ownership of key modules within our B2B SaaS construction technology platform.


In this role, you will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, field/industry experts, design, and engineering. You will be responsible for translating product strategy and customer needs into well\-defined user stories, prioritizing the product backlog, and driving delivery through agile development cycles.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Backlog Management \& Agile Execution**

* **Maintain \& Prioritize Backlog:** Define, groom, and prioritize product backlogs based on business value, customer feedback, and strategic vision.
* **Story Writing \& Acceptance Criteria:** Write detailed user stories, technical requirements, epic descriptions, and clear acceptance criteria (Definition of Done).
* **Sprint Planning \& Ceremonies:** Partner closely with engineering teams in daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives.
* **Feature Delivery:** Serve as the primary decision\-maker during sprint development to clarify requirements and keep engineering teams moving efficiently.

**Domain \& Customer Focus**

* **Deep Domain Understanding:** Develop a granular understanding of construction workflows (e.g., job costing, RFIs/Submittals, field reporting, equipment tracking, BIM integration, or compliance).
* **Voice of the Customer:** Gather continuous feedback from field operators, project managers, and enterprise buyers to refine features and drive product\-market fit.
* **On\-site / Field Insights:** Periodically engage with users through interviews, site visits, and usability testing to validate features.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* **Strategic Alignment:** Work closely with Product Managers to translate the broader roadmap into execution\-ready sprints.
* **Go\-To\-Market Support:** Collaborate with Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to ensure smooth feature launches, documentation, and user onboarding.
* **Data\-Driven Decisions:** Monitor feature adoption, usage metrics, and customer feedback post\-launch to continuously iterate on functionality.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Experience:** 3\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Associate Product Manager in a software environment.
* **Domain Exposure:** Background in Construction Tech, PropTech, Real Estate Tech, or related field/industrial software (ERP, Field Management, CAD/BIM, Asset Management) is strongly preferred.
* **B2B SaaS Experience:** Proven track record in B2B SaaS products, understanding multi\-tenant architectures, user permissions, and enterprise workflow complexities.
* **Agile Proficiency:** Deep understanding of Agile/Scrum frameworks and experience using management tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, or Linear.
* **Communication Skills:** Exceptional ability to synthesize complex field processes into structured, developer\-friendly requirements.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Comfortable discussing technical trade\-offs, APIs, data integrations, and system architecture with engineers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with industry integrations (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, Sage, QuickBooks, Primavera P6\).
* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent product management certification.
* Direct background working in construction management, civil engineering, or project control.

  

About vConstruct: vConstruct specializes in providing high quality Building Information Modeling, Lean Construction, Integrated Project Delivery and Software Solutions for global construction projects. vConstruct is a wholly owned subsidiary of DPR Construction, USA. The Software Unit for vConstruct works on many interesting problems in Construction Technology. It works across different sets of software technologies such as Web Applications, Workflow Management, Analytics, Machine Learning and IoT. For more information, please visit www.vconstruct.com.


DPR Construction is a commercial general contractor and construction manager in USA specializing in technically challenging and sustainable projects for advanced technology, biopharmaceutical, corporate office, and higher education and healthcare markets. With the purpose of building great things—great teams, great buildings, great relationships—DPR is a truly great company. For more information, please visit www.dpr.com.

title: Data Intelligence Manager
description:
**Who we're looking for**



Fieldwire is looking for a Data Intelligence Manager to join our Data \& Operations team based in Pune, India. You will be the operational owner of reporting and analytics for a core business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), turning raw data into accurate, timely, and trusted intelligence that drive decisions at the executive and departmental level. You will work closely with our Data Engineers, DIM Team Lead, and business partners to build dashboards, define KPIs, and maintain rigorous data quality. This role is critical to the integrity and scalability of our reporting landscape.


**What you'll be doing**


**The primary responsibilities for this role include:**


* Own the end\-to\-end delivery of non\-native dashboards for your assigned business function (G\&A, R\&D, or GTM), combining data across multiple source systems into a single, accurate view
* Build, maintain, and continuously improve dashboards and BI products (Power BI or equivalent), ensuring they are always live, accurate, and clearly documented
* Define and govern KPIs and performance metrics for your business area, ensuring consistent definitions across teams and regions
* Act as the primary business partner for stakeholders in your assigned function — translating business questions into analytical requirements and delivering clear, decision\-ready intelligence
* Conduct extensive QA on all data outputs: validate inputs, test transformations, reconcile outputs against source systems, and prevent conflicting or duplicate reporting
* Maintain a single source of truth for your reporting area, ensuring consistency across all dashboards and outputs
* Manage a release and change control process for dashboard updates — including testing, versioning, and stakeholder communication before any changes go live
* Monitor data quality continuously; detect and escalate anomalies, breaks, or integrity issues early
* Document all metrics, logic, and definitions clearly so that any stakeholder can understand what the data means and how it is calculated
* Contribute to cross\-training within the DIM team to ensure coverage and reduce single points of failure
* Support the DIM Team Lead and Director of Operations in roadmap planning and continuous improvement of the reporting landscape


**At Fieldwire, we're looking for our next Data Intelligence Manager to have the following skills and experiences:**


* 3\-5 years of experience in a data analytics, business intelligence, or data intelligence role
* Strong proficiency in SQL and hands\-on experience building dashboards in Power BI
* Experience working with large datasets across multiple systems and understanding how to combine them into coherent reporting
* Demonstrated ability to conduct rigorous QA on data outputs and maintain high standards of accuracy
* Strong analytical and critical thinking skills — able to identify inconsistencies and root\-cause data issues independently
* Experience defining and governing KPIs and metrics frameworks
* Excellent communication skills — able to present complex data findings clearly to non\-technical business stakeholders
* Familiarity with ETL/ELT concepts and how data pipelines work upstream of analytics
* Detail\-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfortable working across time zones in a globally distributed team


**And if you have any of the following, we** **REALLY** **want you to apply today!**


* Experience in a SaaS or technology company, ideally with exposure to GTM, Finance, or R\&D data
* Familiarity with Salesforce reporting and data structures
* Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, or similar modern data stack components
* Exposure to data governance frameworks and metric catalogues
* Prior experience supporting executive\-level reporting or board\-level dashboards
* Background in construction technology or field operations analytics is a plus


**Why Fieldwire?**



The field\-first construction platform for less busywork and more building. Trusted on 4M\+ projects worldwide, Fieldwire by Hilti gives crews reliable access to plans, tasks, and updates on one simple platform. It unites the field and office around a single, transparent source of truth, keeping teams aligned from start to finish. Designed for easy adoption, crews gain real\-time visibility into progress, clear ownership of work, and the context to make confident decisions. As part of the Hilti Group, Fieldwire combines deep construction expertise with modern digital innovation to deliver better outcomes on every job. Learn more at Fieldwire.com.


**Where is the job located?**



This role is hybrid in Pune, India.


*Monday \& Friday: WFH* *2:00 PM–10:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*


*Tuesday\-Thursday \- 1**2:00 PM–8:00 PM IST to align with our global team's operating hours.*


* *\-*


*Fieldwire is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.*

title: Lead Product Manager - Technical
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Lead Product Manager \- Technical
Who is Mastercard?
  

  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
  

  

Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
  

  

Overview
  

  

The Mastercard Dispute Lifecycle team in Pune have an exciting opportunity for a Lead Product Management \- Technical to help further enhance and modernize our Dispute management platform.  

  

The ideal candidate will quickly develop a deep technical understanding of the applications and systems they support, demonstrating a willingness to dive in, challenge assumptions, and ask thoughtful, probing questions to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.  

  

They will bring a strong interest in Payments domain, along with proven technical leadership, and the ability to think creatively applying innovative, out\-of\-the\-box approaches to solve complex problems  

  

Role
  

  

* Customer obsession: Champion a deep understanding of customer needs, the broader ecosystem, and key market dynamics, and embed these insights into product decisions
* Systems analysis \& design: Develop an in\-depth understanding of the product platform and its surrounding ecosystem; produce high\-quality functional artifacts for Engineering, including data flows, sequence diagrams, APIs, and interface specifications
* Backlog management: Define and maintain a clear roadmap aligned to business objectives; translate system designs into well\-structured features and user stories that are ready for Engineering execution
* Story elaboration: Lead refinement sessions and create detailed, comprehensive acceptance criteria to ensure clarity and delivery readiness
* Technical analysis: Provide rigorous analysis of application software to validate that business and functional requirements can be effectively delivered
* Strategic alignment: Partner with stakeholders to ensure backlogs are prioritized and refined based on business value, impact, and measurable outcomes
* Agile mindset: Advocate for and model agile best practices across the product lifecycle—from defining epics to writing actionable user stories and acceptance criteria
* Continuous improvement: Measure outcomes, evaluate existing practices and metrics, and drive ongoing optimization across processes, roles, and delivery execution

  

All About You
  

  

* Proven product experience: Several years of product management or new product development experience delivering high\-quality products, with the ability to clearly articulate business context and customer use cases
* Technical product expertise: Experience managing highly technical platforms or API\-driven services, with strong software architecture and systems design knowledge
* ISO8583 knowledge (preferred): Familiarity with key payments and dispute management concepts is a plus
* Lean \& Agile delivery: Hands\-on experience with Lean product management and agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), along with CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
* End\-to\-end ownership: Demonstrated success delivering features from design through development, deployment, and customer integration
* Backlog management: Expertise in grooming epics, features, and user stories; defining clear acceptance and exit criteria; and effectively prioritizing platform backlogs
* Data\-driven decision making: Ability to define and leverage SMART metrics (leading and lagging) to guide product strategy and measure success
* Collaboration \& stakeholder management: Proven ability to work across global, cross\-functional teams, align diverse perspectives, and manage dependencies and co\-development opportunities
* Thrives in ambiguity: Comfortable navigating uncertainty; proactively identifies solutions, engages the right stakeholders, and drives clarity
* Continuous improvement \& communication: Committed to optimizing team processes for speed, quality, and innovation, with excellent written and verbal communication skills

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
